 Follow Us On: News Sports Cricket IND A vs NEP Live Score: India crush Nepal by 306 runs, get ready for PAK clash Advertisement Rising Stars Asia Cup India A vs Nepal Live Score: India crush Nepal by 306 runs, get ready for Pakistan clash
 India Today Sports Desk Doha , UPDATED: Nov 20, 2026 21:02 IST India A (IND A) vs Nepal (NEP) Live Cricket Score: Prince Yadav and Harshit Rana have wrecked the Nepal batting order. Harshit has got four wickets while Prince picked up a sensational five-wicket haul as India close in on a sensational win. IND A vs Nepal live score. (Image: BCCI X) 
 Hello and welcome to the live coverage of the Rising Stars Asia Cup clash between India A and Nepal. 
 46 Nov 20, 2026 21:01 IST IND vs NEP: INDIA WIN BY 306 RUNS!
 GAME, SET AND MATCH!
 An astonishing collapse from Nepal as they are bundled out for just 26 runs! Harshit Rana and Prince Yadav ripped through the batting line-up, leaving Shahbaz Ahmed with the final say. He tossed one up to Nandan, who charged down the track looking for a big hit but was beaten by the dip and turn. Kumar Kushagra made no mistake behind the stumps, completing a simple stumping to wrap things up. A neat finish from Kushagra, who had already lit up the contest with a brilliant hundred earlier!
 Nov 20, 2026 20:49 IST IND A vs NEP: Prince gets fifer!
 WOW, WOW, WOW!
 This is just an exhibition of pace bowling at its finest. 
 Prince Yadav has bowled at the stumps and first cleans up Pratis with a beauty. Captain Sandeep Lamichhane comes in and is cleaned up for a duck as the stumps are rattled again. He misses his hat-trick, but that last wicket might be saved for Harshit to take his fifer. 
 Nov 20, 2026 20:41 IST WICKET! HARSHIT GETS HIS FOURTH!
 WHAT IS HAPPENING HERE?
 Nepal are falling like nine pins here and they have lost the last three wickets without scoring any runs. Harshit forces Lokesh Bam to play the drive and the ball goes straight into the hands of Abhishek Sharma. That's his fourth and he is on a hat-trick. Pratis is able to prevent that but the pace and swing from Harshit has been sensational. 
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: NEP (21/7 in 5 ov), chasing 333. Pratis (4*), Nandan (0*) 
 advertisement Nov 20, 2026 20:38 IST WICKET! PRINCE GETS HIS THIRD!
 Just as Harshit used the slower ball to perfection, Prince joins in and bowls a slower yorker of his own. Pawan Sarraf can just look in dismay as to what happened here and is now slowly walking back to the pavilion. India are close to a big win and Nepal are actually in danger of getting bowled out soon. 
 Nov 20, 2026 20:34 IST WICKET! HARSHIT GETS HIS THIRD!
 A beauty from Harshit!
 The Indian pacer brings out the slower delivery and Rashid just couldn't resist going for the cover shot. But there is no feet movement and the Nepal batter just got bamboozled in the end. That's third wicket for Harshit and he looks to have used his recovery period well and has added some weapons to his arsenal. 
 India are all over Nepal at the moment and we can sense a big win here. 
 (Screengrab from SonyLiv) 
 Nov 20, 2026 20:24 IST IND A vs NEP live: Harshit making the ball talk
 What has been great to see from Harshit is that he has been targeting the stumps all the time. The pitch looked slow during the first innings, but suddenly he and Prince are extracting pace and swing from the track. He bowls another beautiful over here as Sarraf and Rashid has struggled. 
 Rashid was hit on the helmet here, and the ball went to the boundary. The next one from his back and right on the stumps. This is something that the Gautam Gambhir and Co. will be encouraged by. 
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: NEP (7/4 in 5 ov), chasing 333. Bhurtel (0), Pawan (2*) 
 advertisement Nov 20, 2026 20:10 IST IND A vs NEP: WICKET, Harshit Rana strikes again 
 NEPAL ARE FALLING APART!
 Harshit Rana strikes for the second time as Kushal Bhurtel departs for a four-ball duck.
 It wasn't the best delivery from Rana, drifting down the leg side, but Bhurtel gets a faint touch and Ayush Badoni takes a sharp catch.
 Rana flashes a big smile as India pick up their fourth wicket inside three overs. The Indian pacers are running riot, and Nepal have no answers!
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: NEP (1/4 in 2.2 ov), chasing 333. Bhurtel (0), Pawan (0*) 
 Courtesy: Sony LIV 
 Nov 20, 2026 20:08 IST IND A vs NEP: WICKET, Prince bowls a double wicket maiden 
 PRINCE YADAV ON FIRE!
 The Indian pacer completes a stunning double-wicket maiden, ripping through Nepal's top order with some superb swing bowling.
 After dismissing Deepak Dumre, Prince strikes again to send Basir Ahamad packing for a duck.
 He pitches it up and gets the ball to swing back in sharply, beating Ahamad's inside edge before crashing into off stump.
 Nepal are three down inside two overs and India are all over them!
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: NEP (1/3 in 2.1 ov), chasing 333. Bhurtel (0*), Pawan (0*) 
 Courtesy: Sony LIV 
 Nov 20, 2026 20:06 IST IND A vs NEP: WICKET, Prince Yadav strikes now 
 Nepal are in deeper trouble as India strike again!
 Prince Yadav joins the party, sending Deepak Dumre back for just one. The pacer delivers a full outswinger outside off, drawing the batter into a shot.
 Dumre gets a faint connection and Tilak Varma makes no mistake in the field.
 India's two young pacers are finding movement in the air and making life extremely difficult for Nepal's top order. Nepal lose their second wicket inside two overs!
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: NEP (1/2 in 1.4 ov). Bhurtel (0*), Basir (0*) 
 Courtesy: Sony LIV 
 advertisement Nov 20, 2026 19:59 IST IND A vs NEP: WICKET, Harshit Rana strikes early
 Harshit Rana strikes early and gives India the breakthrough!
 The Indian pacer produces an absolute peach to trap Arjun Kumal leg-before-wicket for a duck in the third over.
 Rana angles the delivery into the right-hander before getting it to nip away sharply, completely beating Kumal's attempted flick.
 The ball crashes into his back leg and would have gone on to hit middle stump. Rana is looking in terrific rhythm and Nepal are already under pressure.
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: NEP (0/1 in 0.3 ov). Bhurtel (0*), Dumre (0*) 
 Courtesy: Sony LIV 
 Nov 20, 2026 19:25 IST IND A vs NEP: INDIA GET TO 332!
 A couple of lusty blows from Suryansh Shedge as India get 332 off their 50 overs. India did lose a lot of wickets in the end, but the batters were chasing runs. Suryansh finishes with 36 off 14 balls and he ensured that the foundation set up by Tilak Verma and Kumar Kushagra, who scored hundreds. 
 The duo saved India from 42 for three and got them to a comfortable position as Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Abhishek Sharma failed to make a mark. Kushagra scored 117 off 102 balls, while Tilak played a captain's knock to ensure that his side put a big total for Nepal to chase. 
 Nov 20, 2026 19:16 IST IND A vs NEP: INDIA LOSE SHAHBAZ, VIPRAJ
 Sandeep Lamichhane is on a hat-trick!
 The Nepal skipper has induced two false shots from Shahbaz Ahmed and Vipraj Nigam as India lose quick wickets in the search of big runs. 
 Harshit Rana faces the hat-trick ball and he does just enough to not get stumped. 
 Nov 20, 2026 19:10 IST IND A vs NEP: INDIA CROSS 300!
 That's wayward from Nandan Yadav and he allows Shahbaz Ahmed to just guide it to the boundary. With that, India's 300 comes up. At one point, it seemed like India may have had to settle a score closer to 250, but hundreds from Kushagra and Tilak have changed everything. 
 And now Suryansh adds to the misery as he sends the final ball of the over out of the park and for a mighty six. 
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: India A (310/6 in 48 ov). Suryansh (17*), Shahbaz (7*) 
 Nov 20, 2026 19:04 IST WICKET! INDIA LOSE RINKU SINGH
 With quick runs being the order of the day, Rinku Singh decides to take on Lamichhane and send him out of the park. But the connection isn't great but Bhurtel almost makes a meal out of this one. He drops the initial attempt but is able to grab hold of the ball on the rebound. 
 Suddenly, India have two new batters in the middle. 
 (Screengrab from SonyLiv) 
 Nov 20, 2026 18:58 IST IND A vs NEP: CAPTAIN TILAK DEPARTS!
 A brilliant, brilliant hundred comes to an end. 
 He brings out the helicopter shot here, maybe a tribute to Dhoni, but the connection isn't enough. It just goes straight to the fielder, but he deserves all the admiration today. After realising that this wasn't a wicket for hard-hitting, he took his time with Kumar Kushagra and the duo have put India on course for a big total. 
 Nov 20, 2026 18:54 IST IND A vs NEP: TILAK HITS HUNDRED!
 WHAT A KNOCK FROM TILAK!
 Tilak Varma brings up his century in style, finding the gap wide of point with a crisp cut shot for four. The Indian batter takes his helmet off and soaks in the applause. He had a few nervy moments early in his innings but has shown tremendous patience to make this opportunity count. Now, he will be keen to give the innings a strong finish!
 The Nepal bowlers have lost the plot now as leaks runs and India are edging closer to the 300-run mark. 
 Nov 20, 2026 18:43 IST WICKET! KUMAR KUSHAGRA DEPARTS AFTER SENSATIONAL KNOCK!
 A brilliant hundred finally comes to an end. The slowness of the track does Kushagra here as he goes for a wild sweep and is cleaned by Rajbanshi. The intent was clear from Kushagra the moment he reached his century and that was to attack the bowlers. The whole dressing room rises up to applaud the wicketkeeper, who saved India from trouble and now have put them on course for a big total. 
 (Screengrab from SonyLiv video) 
 Nov 20, 2026 18:39 IST IND A vs NEP: Tilak joins in on the fun
 The Indian skipper has been a spectator at the other end for most of the time as his partner has been in sensational form and got to his hundred. Now Tilak is freeing his arms and hits it through the off-side for a fine boundary as India are heading towards the 300-run mark. 
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: India A (247/3 in 43 ov). Kushagra (117*), Tilak (85*) 
 Nov 20, 2026 18:35 IST IND A vs NEP: Kushagra keeps attacking 
 Kumar Kushagra is simply unstoppable!
 The centurion has taken Sandeep Lamichhane apart, smashing him for 15 runs in the over with two boundaries and a towering six.
 He first hammered a short delivery between deep square and deep midwicket before bringing out the slog-sweep to clear the ropes at wide long-on.
 He followed it up with another boundary, showcasing his incredible timing and range. Kushagra is batting with breathtaking confidence!
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: India A (237/3 in 41 ov). Kushagra (116*), Tilak (77*) 
 Courtesy: Sony LIV 
 Nov 20, 2026 18:30 IST IND A vs NEP: Kushagra hits brilliant hundred 
 KUMAR KUSHAGRA, TAKE A BOW! 
 The youngster has brought up his third List A century in spectacular fashion, launching Rashid Khan over the ropes to reach the three-figure mark off 93 balls.
 What a sensational knock this has been! Having shifted gears brilliantly after a cautious start, Kushagra has taken Nepal's attack apart with fearless strokeplay and sublime timing.
 He smashed two sixes off Rashid in the over, first moving into the 90s before sealing his hundred in style. A magnificent, chanceless innings that has turned India's fortunes around!
 Rising Stars Asia Cup, IND A vs NEP: India A (221/3 in 40 ov). Kushagra (101*), Tilak (76*)
